title: Rig Relay Correlated Visibility Matrix
summary: Critical path coverage matrix for all Rig Relay subsystems. Maps each critical path to required trace events, correlation fields, artifacts, visibility status, and release-blocker classification. Based on Phase 0 codebase inventory from commit 5b9fa20e.

critical_paths.description: Desktop bridge server startup: frontend resolution, runtime config build, server bind, health probes, browser window creation, and shutdown.
sensitivity_requirements: frontend_dir must be hashed, not logged as raw path
token_present only — token_value_included must be false
no raw auth token in any payload
critical_paths.recommended_fix: None. Add monotonic_ns to span timing for precision if desired.

critical_paths.description: WebSocket upgrade, auth handshake, subscription, projection push, and frontend receipt/rendering.
sensitivity_requirements: auth token value must never appear in trace payload
rejection reasons must not leak token format details
rate_limited events must not leak client identity beyond connection
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add content-light rejection trace events for origin_rejected, invalid_json, unknown_type, unauthenticated_subscribe, oversize_message, rate_limited. Add per-connection connection_id generation and include in websocket lifecycle events.

critical_paths.description: Frontend lifecycle breadcrumbs: boot, runtime config, WebSocket connecting, auth, transport state transitions, projection render, status render, degraded/disconnected.
required_artifacts: frontend trace events via /frontend-event or pywebview bridge
sensitivity_requirements: no auth token in query string or body
handshake_id only — never token value
trace endpoint never derived from ws_url
no POST to /ws
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add frontend_session_id generation in frontendTrace.js (distinct from handshake_id). Add frontend_sequence monotonic counter. Add performance_now_ms for high-resolution frontend timing. Add frontend_disconnected event.

critical_paths.description: WebSocket security rejection events: origin rejected, invalid JSON, unknown type, unauthenticated subscribe, oversize message, rate limiting, token redaction proof.
sensitivity_requirements: rejection reasons must be content-light (no token format, no stack traces)
origin_rejected must not log full untrusted origin if it contains secrets
rate_limited must not expose client fingerprinting data
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add content-light rejection trace events for all six rejection types. Ensure rejection payloads follow redaction rules. Add dedicated security rejection test file.

critical_paths.description: Context assembly pipeline: request received, repo/context sources selected, code schema router invoked, context envelope built, generated HTML excluded, prompt emitted.
sensitivity_requirements: no raw prompt content in trace payload
no generated HTML content in trace
source file paths must be repo-relative only
no agent conversation history in trace attributes
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add TraceRecorder or golden-path events to context assembly pipeline. Emit start/success/failure events with content-light payloads (source counts, budget used, schemas selected). Add schema_id correlation field.

critical_paths.description: Code schema router: registry loaded, authority checked, source hash matched/mismatched, scoring signals, schemas selected, validation commands exposed, untrusted schema warnings.
sensitivity_requirements: no raw schema content in trace
source_hash only — no file contents
untrusted schema warnings must be content-light
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add trace events to code schema router: registry load, authority check, source hash match/mismatch, schema selection, untrusted warnings. Emit schema_id in correlation for selected schemas.

critical_paths.description: Single agent loop turn: user message accepted, context assembled, model request sent, model response received, tool calls resolved, pending tool batch created, batch executed, batch completed/refused/failed.
sensitivity_requirements: no raw user message or model response content in trace
message hashes only — no prompt/response text
tool call arguments must be redacted per redaction rules
failure reasons must not leak model internals
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add light span-based trace events around agent loop turn phases. Generate tool_batch_id at batch creation and propagate to tool execution spans. Content-light payloads only (message hashes, token counts, tool names).

critical_paths.description: Tool execution lifecycle: tool call planned, authorized/refused, input validated, execution started, completed/failed/timed out, receipt emitted, trace linked to receipt.
sensitivity_requirements: tool input arguments must be redacted per redaction rules
tool output must not contain secrets
receipt SHA256 only — no receipt content in trace
failure reasons must not expose filesystem paths outside repo
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add tool_batch_id generation and propagation. Add refused/timed_out trace events. Add input_validated and receipt_emitted events.

critical_paths.description: Worktree mutation lifecycle: branch/head/status captured, dirty files detected, protected dirty files preserved, mutation started, file changed, validation run, checkpoint/commit readiness recorded.
sensitivity_requirements: dirty file paths must be repo-relative only
no file contents in trace payload
protected file refusals must not expose file contents
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add trace events to worktree_manager and coordination mutation paths. Emit start/success/failure/refusal events with content-light payloads (file counts, branch names, SHA hashes).

critical_paths.description: Static documentation site render: JSON docs loaded, schemas loaded, site manifest loaded, homepage rendered, archive rendered, pages rendered, search index written, render manifest written, safety scan, output counts.
sensitivity_requirements: no generated HTML content in trace
output counts only — no file contents
document_id only — no document content
safety scan results must be content-light (pass/fail counts)
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add optional trace events to render_static_docs.py. Emit start/success/failure with output counts, document counts, safety scan pass/fail. Use get_default_trace_store() and build_golden_path_event().

critical_paths.description: Security release gates: threat model loaded, release blockers counted, mitigations tested, unresolved blockers emitted.
sensitivity_requirements: blocker descriptions must be content-light
no full threat model content in trace
mitigation test results must be pass/fail only
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Future: add trace events to release gate validation script. Not yet implemented — threat model is draft status.

critical_paths.description: Agent session lifecycle: session created/opened, trace/evidence paths initialized, compaction/finalization, shutdown/cleanup.
sensitivity_requirements: session paths must be repo-relative or hashed
no session token or secrets in trace
shutdown error must not leak filesystem details
critical_paths.recommended_fix: Add trace events to session lifecycle. Emit session.created, trace_paths_initialized, evidence_paths_initialized, compaction, finalization, and shutdown events.
